parties.name: NewCo Tech Company, Inc. ('NewCo')
parties.description: A Madison, WI startup founded by Baker (CEO) and Carter (CTO), two ex-employees of BigTech. They are developing 'NETWORKFUNCTION,' a software-based routing system for faster internet streaming.

parties.name: BigTechCo, Inc. ('BigTech')
parties.description: A Fortune 100 hardware tech company and former employer of NewCo's founders. BigTech owns the core intellectual property for NETWORKFUNCTION.

caseStudyContext.coreSituation: BigTech has spun-off the NETWORKFUNCTION technology into NewCo. NewCo is now negotiating a term sheet with BigTech to license the core IP and secure initial investment.

newCoStatus.founders: Baker (550,000 shares), Carter (450,000 shares). Shares vest over 4 years with a 1-year cliff.
newCoStatus.needs: Funding to hire 3-5 engineers and 1 marketing officer.
newCoStatus.initialCapitalization: Founders contributed $50,000 for rent and equipment. An employee option pool of 100,000 shares is planned.

proposedTermSheet.grant: Exclusive license to the Core IP in the 'Networking' field for the life of the patents.
proposedTermSheet.equity: BigTech gets a 15% equity stake in NewCo. This 15% ownership is protected by an anti-dilution provision until NewCo raises at least $2.0M in a subsequent financing round.
proposedTermSheet.milestoneFee: A one-time 2% payment on sales for any year where sales reach $10M.
proposedTermSheet.patentCosts: NewCo must pay for all future patent costs. Past costs ($19,971) are waived.
diligenceAndControl: BigTech has the option to be a Board Observer.
NewCo must provide regular business plans, financial statements, and development reports.
First commercial sale must be achieved by May 1, 2019.
If development stalls for 1 year, the license becomes non-exclusive.
proposedTermSheet.futureOfferings: BigTech has pro-rata rights (a preemptive right) to maintain its ownership percentage in future funding rounds. If they participate in the Series A round, they get an option for a board seat.
